body:
weight: light
tier: 1
charter: C5

Build the run loop `factory/bin/run.sh --slot N` (one loop per slot; a shell script, not an agent) and `factory/skills/run/SKILL.md` (/factory:run, from contract to built). Design: docs/spec/SPEC-v0.2.txt "Run loop" (L349-405) as corrected by docs/adr/0005-run-loop-cli-reality.md, which records the real flags of vetto 0.6.5, ralon 0.1.7 and @adlc/cli 1.12.0 `fleet run` (for example vetto takes a policy file with `--policy`, ralon reads `<dir>/agent.lock` via `-C <dir>`, fleet's success is `exitCode 0` with `reason: null`, and `--pre-strike-argv` needs an absolute argv[0]). Code to the real CLIs; never invent a flag.

Each iteration: governor (factory/bin/governor.sh, T8) → claim (factory/bin/claim.sh) → git fetch → worktree (resume from a lapsed `ticket/<id>/*` branch and append its dead-end material, else from `origin/main`) → ralon (lock rendered by factory/bin/lib/ralon-lock.sh, T6) wrapping vetto (factory/policy/build.toml) wrapping `fleet run` → `case` on fleet's reason:
- success (exit 0, reason null) → tamperguard + factory/bin/scope-check.sh locally. scope-check is a step-3 stub that exits 2: the loop records "scope-check not built" and does not push (no false green). When both pass: push `ticket/<id>/<handle>`, open the PR, comment on the Issue.
- quota-paused | wall-clock → keep the lock (heartbeat it), push the partial branch, sleep, resume.
- strikes-exhausted | flail → push the branch, label the Issue needs-desk, delete the lock.
- review-unavailable → delete the lock, sleep reviewUnavailableSleepMinutes.
- anything else (lock-held, ticket-blocked, mirror-fetch-failed, any run-level reason) → delete the lock, comment the reason.
Then remove the worktree. Outbound payloads (PR body, Issue comments, ledger lines) carry gate-manifest hashes, reason codes, strike counts, adapter names and token counts only; never prompt, transcript or file text.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Every branch above is taken for its reason, using a fake fleet that emits each reason and fakes for ralon and vetto that record their argv. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_run.sh, one case per reason).
2. The argv the loop passes to ralon, vetto and fleet matches ADR-0005's real flags. Verify: `make test` (case 'argv').
3. The resume path: a lapsed `ticket/<id>/*` branch is the worktree base and its dead-end material is appended. Verify: `make test` (case 'resume').
4. I8: no prompt or file text in any outbound payload (the test plants a marker string in the ticket body and the fake transcript and greps every payload the loop builds). Verify: `make test` (case 'no-transcript').
5. `--once` runs exactly one iteration. Verify: `make test` (case 'once').
6. scope-check exiting 2 means no push and the record says "scope-check not built". Verify: `make test` (case 'scope-stub').
7. shellcheck -S warning clean. Verify: `make lint`.

Out of scope: CI gate bodies, scope-check's body (step 3); the live smoke (T11).
title: Build the run loop and /factory:run: claim, sandboxed fleet run, and a branch per fleet reason
